control_profile.scope: ONE configuration (mock E7 covariance) x two systems at the registered N0/m/B/N_fit/B_KDE; NOT the production full surviving-size family

negative.model: isotropic model from an independent stream (own CRN group; independent numerator/denominator resampling; own fitting bank and fitting plans)
negative.reference: isotropic reference of the evaluation purpose

fixed_target.expectation: technical ok AND definite False for support and strong (unknown is recorded, never success)

rate_check.rule: Wilson(c+u, n) <= 0.05 over n independent isotropic pseudo thresholds (m=1, pseudo stream 9); unknown counted as possible false support; any technical failure fails
rate_check.scope: one configuration control profile; not the production global calibration

positive_registered.rule: rules §9.3 / A10c: the isotropic REFERENCE bank scaled by 0.35 in T1 and T2 (same clusters, paired), both systems; fitting model = scaled reference fitting bank
positive_registered.expectation: strong full predicate True with precision pass; conjunct battery (registered decider passes, one-conjunct-removed mutants detected)

positive_mock_diagnostic.rule: DIAGNOSTIC ONLY (not a gate): the mock-E7 model banks scaled by 0.6, both systems

brute_force.rule: pure-Python row-loop oracle per cluster vs the actual aggregation path (ConfigBank.hit_tables -> HitTable -> literal resampling sums) for matched and native; detector self-test (zeroed and cluster-permuted aggregations must be caught)

a5_cross_check.expectation: T1/T2 medians and P(T1<=obs), P(E_B) within the pinned A5 intervals

target.source: rules draft4.1 §2.1 / Step0 v0.7 unique row

mock_cov.scope: A11 frozen tilted E7 covariance used as MOCK (not a first-wave configuration)

note: science pins for the B-3-1 official-scale control battery; no self-referencing commit/inventory hashes (outer launcher lock)
